QuestInfo.name: Music Box Parts
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie refuses to let you borrow the sheet music, since it's so valuable. However, he says that he can make a music box that plays Moonlight Sonata for you to take to Grandpa Moon Bunny.\nAll he needs is the right parts...  Hunt some monsters and bring him the parts for an music box.
QuestInfo.2: Gold Richie thanked you for retrieving the lost sheet music, but he said he can't let you borrow the sheet music.  Instead, you brought him Music Box Cylinders for him to make a music box with.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 500\n\nCan proceed to the 'Moonlight Sonata Music Box' quest

0.0: I can't believe it! I thought I would never see this sheet music again. Now all I have to do is show this sheet music to you, right?\r\n#L0#s#bGrandpa Moon Bunny wants Baby Moon Bunny to hear this song. Can I borrow this sheet music for a few days?#l\n#k
0.1: That will be tough. All I promised was to show you the sheet music. What would happen if I were to let you borrow it, and then you lost it? Here, I have a counteroffer. If you simply need the music to be played, I will put the music into a music box. That is, if you can bring me the parts for the music box. Isn't that a fair deal?

yes.0: We have a deal. Get some #bMusic Box Cylinders#k from the monsters and bring them back to me. All monsters should carry them. I think #b10#k should be enough.

no.0: Well, there's nothing I can do if you can't accept such a fair deal. There's always a price to pay in order to obtain something you want. Don't forget that.

1.0: Good, that should be enough. If you can wait a minute, I will make the music box for you.

default.0: Get some #bMusic Box Cylinders#k from the monsters and bring them back to me. All monsters should carry them. I think #b10#k should be enough.
